- Requirement: "Reject editor-modified Git config and attributes before restoring credentials." (linked issue #6456 Recommendation section — implies rejecting command-executing config keys that the autofix and changelog claim are refused, specifically `core.hooksPath`, `core.editor`, `core.pager`)
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:31 — the `hazard_re` regex `core\.` alternation must include `hooksPath`, `editor`, and `pager`
  Evidence of absence: The alternation at line 31 is `core\.(askpass|sshcommand|gitproxy|fsmonitor|attributesfile|alternaterefscommand)`. None of `hooksPath`, `editor`, or `pager` appear. The agents.md at lines 484-485 documents that the helper "refuses command-running Git keys (filter/diff/merge drivers, core.attributesFile, core.hooksPath, core.editor, core.pager, signing programs, lfs.*)". The changelog entry lists "hook-path, editor, pager, signing, LFS". The test at tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py:311-318 expects restore to refuse `core.hooksPath`, `core.editor`, and `core.pager` in both local and global scope. The implementation does not deliver what its own documentation claims.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Reject editor-modified Git config and attributes before restoring credentials." (linked issue #6456 — the attributes file should not fall back to HOME when no XDG config directory is set)
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:135 — the `has_attributes_hazard` `global_path` computation must guard against editor-writable HOME paths
  Evidence of absence: Line 135 is `global_path="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-${HOME:-}/.config}/git/attributes"`. The test at tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py:374-378 was written to assert that the HOME fallback is removed (`global_path=""` when unset, `elif` branch for HOME presence, no `${HOME:-}/.config/git/attributes` literal). None of these assertions match the implementation. An editor process can write `${HOME}/.config/git/attributes` for subsequent `git add` operations.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
